conversions.pr: kg m-2 s-1 times 86,400 = mm/day liquid water equivalent
conversions.rsds: W m-2 times 0.0864 = MJ m-2 day-1
conversions.hurs: daily mean percent; clipped to [0, 100] only if model exceeds physical bounds, counts recorded
conversions.sfcWind: m s-1 at 10 m, no change

model_source: Ruslan fstasks layered bucket, with Marsden SSURGO top 1 m, FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, shared local thermal reference, 50% available water on October 1 before the full run, 10% daily gravity-water drainage, fixed May 1 planting, and no irrigation.

phenology_reference.source: NASA POWER daily T2M_MAX and T2M_MIN (MERRA-2)
phenology_reference.method: 31-day circular moving mean of the historical grid temperatures, shared across all scenarios
phenology_reference.limitation: Only the two complete Marsden years already available in the project; not climatological normals.

kc_mid.note: adjusted for climate with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.note: 0.60 if harvested at high grain moisture; 0.35 if field-dried

root_min_m.source: FAO-56, ch. 8 (Zr at sowing 0.15-0.20 m; roots grow to Zr max by start of mid-season)

p.source: FAO-56, Table 22 (rooting depth Zr, depletion fraction p)
p.note: adjusted p = p + 0.04 (5 - ETc), FAO-56 Table 22 footnote

gdd_base_c.source: Iowa State Univ. Extension (GDD 86/50 °F method = base 10 °C, cap 30 °C)

gdd_cap_c.source: Iowa State Univ. Extension (GDD 86/50 °F method = base 10 °C, cap 30 °C)

residue_cover.source: FAO-56, ch. 11 (soil evaporation reduced ~5% per 10% of surface covered by residue)

kc_mid.note: Handoff choice for dense sunflower stand

root_min_m.source: FAO-56, ch. 8 (Zr at sowing 0.15-0.20 m; roots grow to Zr max by start of mid-season)

soil_source: USDA SSURGO Soil Data Access chorizon, IA015 2026-09-08, mukey 2834849, cokey 28627779 (Nicollet, 85%); horizons 85967582, 85967581, 85967584, 85967583

assumptions.reference_et: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, with daily mean relative humidity and wind adjusted from 10 m to 2 m.
assumptions.kc_climate_adjustment: Table coefficients; daily minimum relative humidity is unavailable.
assumptions.sunflower_calendar: FAO-56 Table 11 Mediterranean/California stage lengths transferred to Marsden.
assumptions.rotation_effects: Modeled water and snow carry-over without annual resets, crop-specific growth and demand.

definitions.deficit_mm: Sum of potential minus actual crop water use, cropped days only.
definitions.water_shortfall_pct: 100 times deficit divided by modeled potential water use.
definitions.drought_stress_days: Ruslan daily closing root-zone storage below its modeled stress threshold, after establishment.
definitions.drought_stress_crop_day_pct: 100 times drought stress days divided by all crop days.
definitions.water_stress_days: Unavailable because waterlogging stress is not modeled.
